name: search-kb
description: Search OKF knowledge before SDLC work

spec.why: Provide a read-only, source-backed knowledge search skill across agent surfaces, with behavioral evaluations and Copilot workspace installation.

requirements.text: Discover the actual bundle and retrieve relevant concepts through the existing CLI or read-only Markdown fallback.
Consume OKF links, source attribution, lifecycle and advisory trust without inventing current facts or owner authority.
Return source-backed SDLC context, conflicts and gaps while preserving workspace bytes and owner gates.
Ship search-kb from the authoritative harness to all four surfaces and install it to the requested Copilot workspace.
Run actual behavioral evaluations, repository gates and independent review before raising the PR.
Full project init MUST create concise AGENTS.md with observed repository paths/commands, wiki retrieval, SDLC usage and preserved project-rule references.
Before replacing existing AGENTS.md, init MUST preserve its exact bytes as AGENTS.backup.md and MUST NOT overwrite a prior differing backup.
Guide/backup actions MUST be visible in dry-run/JSON, idempotent across surfaces, guarded against unsafe paths/source drift, and preserved during removal.

out_of_scope: Knowledge runtime changes or new indexes
Hook protocol changes or cloud bootstrap
Owner acceptance, Start or Finish actions performed by agents
Executing project scripts during guide discovery

decisions.decision: Use search-kb as a read-only consumer of the existing knowledge CLI with a Markdown fallback.
decisions.because: Existing retrieval is sufficient; adding runtime/index behavior expands the request. Reversible instruction change.

decisions.decision: Ship one shared skill to four surfaces, route relevant SDLC context to it, and validate it with blind behavioral fixtures.
decisions.because: Avoid host duplicates and mandatory work on unrelated steps; real evaluations establish behavior beyond wording checks. Reversible packaging/routing change.

decisions.decision: Generate a concise project guide deterministically from a canonical template, observed manifest/path data, wiki commands and preserved project instructions.
decisions.because: Specific observed commands and links follow the requested guidance without inventing architecture or requiring an LLM/network. Reversible template/renderer change.

decisions.decision: Create the guide on full project init with opt-out; preserve byte-exact AGENTS.backup.md, refuse differing backup collisions even with force, and preserve both root documents on removal.
decisions.because: Avoid backup loss and repeated multi-host rotation; global/hooks-only operations retain their scope. Reversible with retained original bytes and explicit user action.

designs.detail: Register canonical manifest component, route selectively, and use existing installer guards.

designs.title: Project-guide generation and backup lifecycle
designs.detail: Use D-3/D-4 template, context discovery, truthful planning, input preflight and safe publication; preserve shared root documents outside ordinary removable outputs.
